decisions.reason: As a product that builds on the firm's established postpress offer and remained on its own webpage through 2024 in a growing market, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough to retain while fitting the firm's automation-oriented portfolio.

Because this close-to-core add-on stayed visible in 2024 and was backed by a concrete customer-use result showing integrated cutting, creasing, perforating, and folding in one pass, management would likely judge it as satisfactory enough to keep despite some residual uncertainty.
